How it works

Your how-to video goes here

Mercedes records it: film the clips, drop them in, double-click the installer, open CapCut.

  1. Film your clipsThe shot list says what to film and for how long. Hold your phone upright and start each clip right on the action.
  2. Drop them inUnzip the template and put your clips in the folder "1 Put your clips here", named 1, 2, 3 in shot-list order.
  3. Double-click the installer"2 Double-click to install" copies the template into CapCut under a new name and adds your clips. Your other projects stay as they are.
  4. Type your wordsOpen CapCut: the template is on the home screen. Double-click each text box, type over the [brackets], and export.
  5. Add a sound and postPick a sound in Instagram after you upload, then share it.

Who it's for

Online business owners and creators who want a Halloween Reel that sells something: a product, a sale, a freebie or an offer. It works for physical products, digital products and services, since every clip is your own footage.

Questions

Do I need CapCut on a computer?
For the full template, yes: it opens in CapCut for computer (the free download). Install it and open it once before you run the installer.
Can I use it on my phone?
Yes. Every template comes with a phone kit: the shot guide video, the shot list and the graphics as PNG images. In the CapCut phone app you add your clips and words, then place the graphics as overlays. The full animation is built for you in the computer version.
Is music included?
No sound files are included, so your Reel never gets muted for a song you don't have the rights to. Each template suggests a sound [SOUND PICKS]. Add it in Instagram after you upload: on a business account, Instagram only shows sounds cleared for business use.
Do I need to install any fonts?
No. The big Halloween lettering is part of the artwork. The words you edit use Arial or Bodoni Moda, and Bodoni Moda comes inside the template.
How do I change the words?
Double-click a text box in CapCut and type over the [brackets]. Keep it to a few words so people can read it in time.
My computer warns me about the installer. Is that normal?
Yes, Windows shows this for installers it hasn't seen before. Choose More info, then Run anyway.
What if I want a different clip in one shot?
Right-click the clip on CapCut's timeline, choose Replace, and pick another.

Listing description

Five cute Halloween Reel templates for CapCut, each with a selling job: open a once-a-year sale, show what's included, share your favourites, turn a common mistake into your offer, or announce a last chance. Film a few clips on your phone, drop them in a folder and double-click the installer: the template opens in CapCut with your clips in place. Type your words over the brackets and export. Each template comes with a shot list, a recipe card, a one-page guide and a phone kit. Each one suggests a sound to add in Instagram (no sound files included).

Demo footage to film

One finished demo Reel per template, made from your own clips run through the real installer. Never the after.mp4 previews (they show other brands' products). Use your own product throughout, for example a Scrolly tee or the Business Brain on your laptop screen. Also film the how-to video for the How it works section.
